expected.methodology: Median of comparable asks per GPU model. Each quoted ask is adjusted to an on-demand, US-baseline, reference-memory price (interruptible and reserved discounts reversed, regional cost factor removed) before the median is taken. Coverage counts the providers, regions and offers behind the number.
limitations: advertised asks, not transacted prices and not utilisation
median of a small population; coverage is reported and must be read with the value
adjustment factors are stated assumptions, not estimated parameters
built on sample offers: illustrative, never observed
history is the model's on-demand series rescaled to today's adjusted median
